description: This file defines the GoteoCore class implementing ExtensionInterface, providing utility functions for request handling, user session management, configuration, and other application-level features within the Goteo project.

classes.name: GoteoCore
classes.description: Implements ExtensionInterface, providing core utility functions for the Goteo application.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the static request object.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the static request object, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the extension with optional arguments.

methods.name: provideFilters
methods.description: Returns an empty array of filters.

methods.name: provideFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of callable functions for templates or other uses.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Returns the application's debug status.

methods.name: asset
methods.description: Generates URL for assets.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Retrieves application messages.

methods.name: errors
methods.description: Retrieves application errors.

methods.name: get_cookie
methods.description: Gets a cookie value.

methods.name: get_session
methods.description: Gets a session value.

methods.name: is_ajax
methods.description: Checks if the request is an XMLHttpRequest.

methods.name: is_pronto
methods.description: Checks if the request is a 'pronto' AJAX request.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Retrieves GET parameters.

methods.name: get_post
methods.description: Retrieves POST parameters.

methods.name: has_query
methods.description: Checks if a GET parameter exists.

methods.name: has_post
methods.description: Checks if a POST parameter exists.

methods.name: get_uri
methods.description: Gets the current request URI.

methods.name: get_pathinfo
methods.description: Gets the path info from the request.

methods.name: get_querystring
methods.description: Gets the query string from the request.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values.

methods.name: get_main_url
methods.description: Gets the main URL of the application.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Gets the URL, optionally for a specific language.

methods.name: get_user
methods.description: Retrieves the current user object.

methods.name: get_user_menu
methods.description: Retrieves the user's global menu.

methods.name: get_sidebar_menu
methods.description: Retrieves the user's sidebar menu.

methods.name: get_user_location
methods.description: Retrieves the user's location, creating one based on IP if necessary.

methods.name: get_main_menu
methods.description: Retrieves the main menu.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Gets currency information.

methods.name: get_currency
methods.description: Gets current currency.

methods.name: has_role
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific role in a node.

methods.name: is_admin
methods.description: Checks if the user is an admin.

methods.name: is_module_admin
methods.description: Checks if the user is admin of a specific module.

methods.name: is_logged
methods.description: Checks if the user is logged in.

methods.name: is_master_node
methods.description: Checks if the current node is a master node.
